objects.name: Analytic 2047
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies the full firmware modification chain: a device entering firmware-update mode, receiving a large data transfer on a firmware-capable protocol port from a source not in the approved engineering workstation list, rebooting, and reporting a post-reboot firmware hash that does not match the authorized inventory. This technique-level analytic synthesizes System Firmware (T1693.001) and Module Firmware (T1693.002). OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the action is not attributable to an authorized operator/engineering source for the specific target and function, and it is either outside an approved change/maintenance window or lacks matching change-control context; where telemetry permits, require corroborating device, configuration, or process-state effect. Suppress activity that fully matches approved maintenance, commissioning, failover, recovery, or tested control procedures.
